carryover.text: client/brazilianportugui still uses bare 'Block A'-style master-plan.md/status.md headings instead of the BP.<phase>.<letter> convention already applied to amistad (AM) and price-scout (PS). A prior rename attempt was silently clobbered by that repo's own concurrent SDLC flow (worktrees for 1.E-class-page-and-booking-flow-2/-3 were live, and a competing commit landed mid-edit). Wait until that flow settles (no live worktrees, clean git status) before retrying the rename, and commit immediately once done to avoid the same race. See core/mev/planning/decisions/D8-portfolio-kind-terminal-repos.md for the sibling repos' completed rename pattern to replicate.
carryover.clears_when: brazilianportugui's master-plan.md/status.md/state.json block ids are renamed to BP.<phase>.<letter> and committed
